items.title: Nick Mondello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 19, 2022
items.q: "'Body and Soul' I believe was written by Johnny Green?"

ctx.x: You had mentioned technology and at some point we mentioned 78s. So this is “Body and Soul”/“Foxtrot” Coleman Hawkins and his Orchestra. I wonder if you can imagine, if you were writing reviews back in that time, what was this, late 30s if you think about that recording what would you have — what would have been your entry point? What would you have focused on?

Wow. Normally I try to take some aspect of the recording and bring like a metaphor into it, okay? And then use that as a launch point for the review of the music itself. Okay? So let’s say for example “Body and Soul.” “Body and Soul” I believe was written by Johnny Green?
Yes. Heyman, Green, there are four names here.
